author: Xufen Tu
title: 自动化越多，人越需要保留自己的确认环节
observation: When accounts, phone numbers, third-party permissions, automated code, paid tools, and deployment platforms become mixed together, ordinary users may lose track of what has been authorized, changed, connected, or paid for.
current_judgment: AI and automation can accelerate work, but humans need clear confirmation points, rollback paths, and the ability to understand and stop consequential actions.
boundary: Automation should not proceed in ways that remove human understanding, meaningful confirmation, account control, permission awareness, or the ability to stop and repair.
